channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Aerostar's $173 million Luis Muñoz Marín airport parking garage, Hilton's new San Juan dual-brand hotel, Aeroméxico's new Mexico City–San Juan route for 2027, Pep Boys' renovation program and Fazoli's expansion show outside operators continuing to invest. AES Puerto Rico's term sheet to extend Guayama operations to 2032, with about $820 million in planned investment, and a $20 million Department of War apparel contract for a Mayagüez firm are further wins. Risks are concentrated in energy: the P3 Authority is demanding accountability from LUMA over roughly $1 billion in unspent funds, the government has moved to cancel New Fortress Energy's gas contract, and small-business power bills are rising.
